{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693914084,"sessionID":"ses_e23ea0076ffe1kBAx2l1A1NYSB","part":{"id":"prt_1dc17dadf001pg3hN3GZoZeqoo","messageID":"msg_1dc17ba44001GqvhE7X4vE4neF","sessionID":"ses_e23ea0076ffe1kBAx2l1A1NYSB","type":"text","text":"I found and fixed four separate causes. All edge services were back to 0% errors by minute 85 and stayed there until the shift ended at minute 120. No throttles are on and every service is back at its normal replica count.\n\n| Cause | Customer impact | Fix | Recovered by |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **ledger-svc** deploy v80 (min −16) cut the call deadline 10× (`budget_ms / 10000`), so calls timed out. Retries then kept it overloaded. | web-storefront, mobile-api and partner-api, through push-svc and media-svc | Rolled back (min 15). It stayed overloaded from retries, so I scaled it 3→6 at min 51, then back to 3. | ~min 55 |\n| **profile-db** deploy v116 (min −26) changed `row.get(\"currency\",\"EUR\")` to `row[\"currency\"]`, which raised a KeyError in recommendations-svc. | admin-portal at about 4%, through recommendations-svc and disputes-svc | Scaled 4→8 first so retries during the rollback wouldn't overload it, then rolled back. Back to 4 afterwards. | ~min 57 |\n| **suggest-svc** deploy v66 (min −128) leaked memory: 0.99 mem and repeated restarts, plus a retry storm. | mobile-api, through checkout-svc and labels-svc | Rolled back (min 57). Scaled 6→18 at min 65 because it still looked overloaded, then back to 6. | ~min 66 |\n| **labels-svc** config cfg-44 started during the shift (min 57) and dropped `rate_limit_per_s` from 5000 to 50. | mobile-api (429 errors) | Reverted the config (min 83). | ~min 85 |\n\n**What cost the most:**\n- **admin-portal:** it earns $21,300/min, so its 4% error rate cost about $850/min until minute 57. Because its error rate was steady and below the alert threshold, it took me until about minute 45 to trace it to profile-db.\n- **ledger-svc:** I should have added replicas at the same time as the rollback. It stayed overloaded from about minute 20 to minute 54, which kept web-storefront and partner-api failing longer.\n- **mobile-api:** it ran at about 90% errors until minute 85. The suggest-svc leak and then the labels-svc rate limit kept it down.\n- **suggest-svc scale-up:** the scale to 18 turned out to be unnecessary. It had already recovered before the extra replicas arrived, so that cost a few hundred dollars for nothing.\n\nI didn't apply any mitigations to services that didn't need them.","time":{"start":1794693913311,"end":1794693914080}}}
